Name: IonBallEX
Description: A brick-breaking game with power-ups, boss fights and a science-fiction setting.

Achievements.Name: Hands Free
Achievements.Description: IonBall is in play for more than 30 seconds without touching the bat

Achievements.Name: Double Time
Achievements.Description: Hold Fastball and Multiball mutators at the same time

Achievements.Name: Triple Threat
Achievements.Description: Have three balls in play at the same time

Achievements.Name: Eight Ball
Achievements.Description: Destroy 8 bricks in a row without the ball touching the platform

Achievements.Name: Wipeout
Achievements.Description: Destroy all remaining bricks with bomb mutator

Achievements.Name: Brass Balls
Achievements.Description: Max out the ball power upgrade

Achievements.Name: Spread it out
Achievements.Description: Apply every upgrade at least once in a game
